active_loop.feedback: After each queried batch, reveal the frozen binary labels for those rows, refit from scratch on all screened rows, and query the highest-scoring remaining rows.
active_loop.ranking_ties: Stable descending score order over the canonical ascending record-identity order.
active_loop.termination: Continue until every canonical row has an order position; do not stop at a favorable recall threshold.

balancer.implementation: At every fit, positive selected rows receive weight 1.0; negative selected rows receive positives/(9.8*negatives); normalize weights to mean one.
balancer.name: ASReview balanced components

comparator.provenance: Pinned ASReview ELAS u4 components previously frozen against asreview/asreview commit 1788bc97ff5b5652dbe1e5b5ad5253bef1b03aef; batch cadence is matched to the candidate rather than the application default.

decision_rule: Use the positive terminal only if G1 through G6 all pass. Use CANNOT_CHECK if G1 or G2 fails. Otherwise retain every measured effect and use the negative terminal. No controller tuning, comparator replacement, margin change, review exclusion, or outcome deletion is allowed.

estimands.primary: Unweighted mean across the five reviews of candidate recall@10% minus comparator recall@10%.
estimands.wss_at_95: 0.95 minus the fraction screened, counting seed rows, at the first rank reaching ceil(0.95 * number of included rows).

forbidden_claims: exact execution of the ASReview application
independent review-level observations merely because the five review names are distinct
population-wide, domain-general, source-general, model-general, or workflow-general superiority
ORION-specific superiority, route invention, closure, or task completion
retrospective controller, comparator, seed, batch, endpoint, margin, exclusion, or review selection

gates.G1_BINDING: Every source, rights, preflight, PubMed snapshot, protocol and implementation hash matches its freeze.
gates.G2_POPULATION: All five review schemas, missing-metadata exclusions, duplicate excess counts, canonical review counts and canonical total match the pre-outcome expectations; every review contains both classes.
gates.G3_PRIMARY_MARGIN: The unweighted review-level mean candidate-minus-u4 recall@10% is at least +0.05.
gates.G4_WORK_SAVING: The unweighted review-level mean candidate-minus-u4 WSS@95 is nonnegative.
gates.G5_HARM: The worst review candidate-minus-u4 recall@10% is at least -0.05.
gates.G6_ABSOLUTE_WORK_SAVING: Candidate WSS@95 is strictly greater than zero in every review.

initialization.order: The positive seed is first and the negative seed second.
initialization.rule: Within each label class and review, select the row minimizing SHA-256(review identity, a NUL byte, record identity). This is one label-informed positive and one label-informed negative per review.

population.content: Whitespace-normalized title followed by abstract. PMID-only review text is joined from the frozen local PubMed snapshot; Fluoride and Neuropain text comes from the frozen supplementary workbooks.
population.cross_review_overlap: Retain records shared across reviews because reviews are distinct screening decisions. Report pairwise overlap and do not claim complete statistical independence; the pre-outcome maximum shared content identity is 68.
population.deduplication: Within each review, compute SHA-256 over the case-sensitive whitespace-normalized concatenation of title, one space, and abstract, exactly as used by the pinned pre-outcome structure audit; retain the earliest source row for each content identity without reading its label.
population.exclusion: Exclude PMID-only rows absent from the frozen PubMed snapshot and rows whose normalized title plus abstract is empty. No other row or review exclusion is allowed after outcomes.

reporting.aggregate: Report every gate, the unweighted mean, and the worst review. Do not replace review-level reporting with a pooled row-level effect.
reporting.per_review: Report source, eligible and canonical counts, label counts, duplicate excess, batch size, feature counts, model fits, order hashes, all metrics for both arms, and candidate-minus-comparator effects.
reporting.text_boundary: Do not write PubMed or workbook titles/abstracts into result or report artifacts.

v2_mechanics_only_change: Replace the incorrect V1 content-identity implementation with the exact identity already used by the outcome-blind prefreeze audit. No scientific design element changes.
